notes.title: v.0.2.1.6
notes.notes: [p]Hi hello yes[/p][p][/p][p]Unfortunately v.0.2.2 is not here yet, was starting work on it when I noticed some bugs that desperately needed fixin'. Since it included a MAJOR softlock I decided to tackle it in another patch instead of in v.0.2.2[/p][p][/p][p]Alright, here are the patch notes:[/p][list][*][p]Improved death spectating, you no longer need to hold right click to move and look around.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed a softlock with group buttons due to previous presses being counted on top of the current one, resulting in a negative number of presses remaining and the group button being stuck in an invalid state[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed "EMERGENCY PROCEDURE" in the lobby being anchored to nothing, and thus phasing through the floor when the elevator descended[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]yapping about v.0.2.2 and the future (please ignore)[/h3][p]Work on v.0.2.2 has been going well. I've started work on the 2 new maps and settings (which actually is in the game rn but in an unusable state). You can expect v.0.2.2 in about 2-3 weeks. I won't dive in too deep on the future of FD because it's pretty boring. Most of the features that you'll expect on release have already been added, so the biggest issue I need to tackle right now are the maps. Get ready for the next major update cycle to not be focused on features, but instead on maps. A whole bunch of 'em fully modeled, textured and polished. [/p][p][/p][p]Anyways FD's development is going well, and I think I can get a fun, playable demo out in time of the next fest and the game fully ready for release by the end of october. [b]But then again, in true nofacegames fashion, never expect a game to release by the time i say it will :P[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for playing FD. Now go have fun.[/p][p][i]-NoFaceGames[/i][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: v.0.2.1.5
notes.notes: [p]sup fellas[/p][p][/p][p]Sorry for the long wait for this patch. Was in hospital. Am ok now haha :D[/p][p][/p][p]This build [b]finally[/b] fixes multiplayer. I know I said I'd fix it in v.0.2.2, but I lied. Anyways, after hours of crying in a corner and dealing with the absolutely EMPTY documentation of the transport layer I'm using, proud to announce I've finally fixed multiplayer. I even tested it myself; [b]it works.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Patch notes:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed multiplayer[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a softlock with group buttons where if a player dies or disconnects after it was pressed, the button ignores previous presses and resets to the original value and prevents players from pressing it again[/p][/*][*][p]Changed wording of friends-only lobby type to be more accurate. It used to be private which technically was wrong[/p][/*][/list][h3][/h3][h3]k so what's next[/h3][p]With this fixed, I can finally switch focus onto the next major version, v0.2.2. You can expect the next 2 maps and for the game to be a little more polished with music, sound effects, text chat, perks and more. Also, some bugs (all related to multiplayer) still remain. These are all mostly visual, and do not prevent players from playing the game. Pretty sure I patched the final bug caused by multiplayer to result in a softlock (somewhat). If any major bugs do pop up, they'll be fixed in v.0.2.2, not in another patch. Promise.[/p][p][/p][p]Oh yeah; don't get too attached to the maps. They're gonna be overhauled with actual textures (and probably reworked)[/p][p][/p][p]See you soon. Thanks for playing.[/p][p][/p][p]-NoFaceGames[/p]

notes.title: v.0.2.1.4
notes.notes: [p]Hi everyone. Sorry for the lack of patches. Been ill. Y'all should send me "gws" messages.[/p][p][/p][p]Anyways, this update focus on patching a few bugs found through playtesting. Multiplayer (probably) works but I haven't tested it fully yet. If it still doesn't work, I'll probably fix it in v.0.2.2 instead of another patch.[/p][p][/p][p]Patch notes incoming:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed being unable to jump out of the water easily at the shop[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed lobby list in pause menu being too elastic[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed voting countdown timer not running out[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed "PlayersAlive" count updating incorrectly due to the game not decreasing the players alive once a player disconnects. A "DeadPlayer" dictionary is now stored on the host and if the player that disconnects is not in the dictionary, "PlayersAlive" will decrease correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a potential softlock with group buttons if a player disconnects. Previously group buttons would calculate required presses when a player disconnects through the amount of connected clients, now it does it through the fixed "PlayersAlive" count. (NOTE: just realized ANOTHER bug with group buttons while typing this. If one or more players pressed the button before it updates, those presses will be ignored. However, players won't be able to press the button again. Fix later.)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the game endlessly trying to join a lobby that doesn't exist. Now it'll time out after 5 seconds. Might up the time depending on player feedback. lmk[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed shop text that is supposed to appear in the elevator appearing when you're not in the elevator on map load[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]k see yerrrrrrr[/p][p][/p][p][i]-NoFaceGames[/i][/p]

notes.title: v.0.2.1
notes.notes: [p]Hello, and welcome to the first build available on Steam![/p][p][/p][p]As said previously, this build does not contain any (major) new content. Instead, I focused on integrating Steamworks and working on some QoL additions/feedback from playtesting.[/p][p][/p][p]Alright, let's get into the patch notes:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Added full Steamworks integration[/p][/*][*][p]Added coyote time[/p][/*][*][p]Added an ingame menu (accessible via \[Esc]) to replace the terrible "Hold Escape to leave game" popup that didn't work half the time. Also this ingame menu shows you the lobby list and join code![/p][/*][*][p]Added a lobby map. Wait for players inside and run around, enter elevator to start game. There's a very terrible "How to play" billboard there. Go read it.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a large "SHOP" sign to the shop as players who were at the shop didn't know they were shopping at the shop because the shop wasn't clear enough that the shop was a shop.[/p][/*][*][p]Added "Buy - " prefix to the purchase buttons at the shop[/p][/*][*][p]Added configurable maximum lobby size[/p][/*][*][p]Updated player model (no animations yet, kek)[/p][/*][*][p]Improved what happens when the whole lobby is dead! You now continue onto the shop. Also when the host dies the lobby NO LONGER closes. (HOWEVER if the host dies the game becomes softlocked as the host is the only player able to descend the elevator. I just realized this while typing. I go fix later.)[/p][/*][*][p]Improved being underwater. Your screen is tinted and your FOV decreases.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved player hitbox. You should slide off of edges less now. If you still do, skill issue lmao[/p][/*][*][p]Improved voting menu: "Time left" text is now below the countdown bar, made the vote button the entire description background, and the timer is skipped once all players have voted! Hooray.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed ability to push other players (i have no idea if it works now tho)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed movement being too jittery (literally made it potentially worse by tying it to framerate)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed group buttons incorrectly updating once a player died. This should be the FINAL FIX to group buttons. Oh how I hate them so much[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed something to do with the exit text NOT updating at all when a player disconnects. I think it was due to a check that was always false, I dunno[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed being unable to jump in very shallow water[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some more minor bugs I forgot[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Next major update will be focused on Map2 and Map3, music/sound effects and perks![/p][p]okies bye[/p][p][/p][p][i]-NoFaceGames[/i][/p]
